method: All eight printed pages read from the supplied Part 1 PDF at 3x zoom (whole-page renders plus glyph-level checks of every number and ambiguous token), with explicit local traversals recorded per page. Ordered source blocks include every instructional bullet, table row/cell, flowchart step, diagram label, arrow annotation, legend entry and caption. Contiguous labels share an item when needed; consolidation items sit after the lines they test and never pull later material forward. Headers, timestamps, footers and blank Active space excluded.
caveats: p740: '2nd urine sample of morning' is the printed wording (standard teaching is second voided midstream); '2-8°C upto 12 hours' and 'Formaldehyde Glutaraldehyde' printed without comma; 'Imepenem' prints as in image (standard Imipenem); 'ENaC blocker' bracket for triamterene taught as printed.

p741: 'Other properties' table prints specific gravity 1.020-1.040 vs 1.010 and osmolality 800-900 vs 285-290; acidification diagram prints 'Non titratable, major acid' for NH4+ and 'Titratable acid' for H2PO4-; 'Isosthenuria (Urinary parameters = Blood parameters)' prints with equality sign.

p742: Causes sum to 100% (90% urological, 9% nephrological, 1% hematological) with 'Carcinoma bladder (m/c)' as printed; centrifugation '1600 rpm X 5 minutes' and 'Sample undisturbed for 3-6 hours' taught as printed; 'myoglobin (short t1/2)' vs 'Hemoglobin (long t1/2)' with t1/2 notation taught verbatim.

p743: Types of RBC images label 'Crenated', 'Isomorphic', 'Dysmorphic', 'Acanthocytes (mickey mouse RBCs)' with Mickey Mouse icon; dipstick table prints color squares and notes 'High specificity, poor sensitivity' for leukocytes/nitrites and 'Proximal RTA: Euglycemic glycosuria' and 'SGLT2 inhibitors: Euglycemic ketosis' for glucose row.

p744: Uromodulin/Tamm Horsfall 70-80 mg/day printed as most abundant component and matrix of casts from thick ascending limb; proteinuria table prints '<150 Normal', '150-500 Functional: Stress anxiety menses protein supplements', '>500 Significant', '>300 Significant in pregnancy'; albumin chain 'Albumin → Tubular injury → Inflammation → TGF-β → Fibrosis' taught as printed.

p745-746: Cast formation 'Distal Convoluted Tubule (DCT)' printed (standard distal tubule/collecting duct); 'Muddy brown' for tubular epithelial cast, 'Broad cast' + 'Waxy cast' → CKD, 'Fatty cast' → Lipiduria/Fabry's, 'Eosinophil cast' → ATN/AIN, 'Fractured cast (On biopsy)' → Myeloma taught as printed; 'Acute Interstitial Necrosis (AIN)' prints where AIN usually expands to Acute Interstitial Nephritis.

p747: Crystal images label 'Rhomboid', 'Bipyramidal/envelope shaped', 'Dumb bell shaped', 'Star shaped (in alkaline urine)', 'Coffin lid appearance' for struvite (MgNH4PO4), 'Broom brush appearance' for amoxicillin, and 'Hexagonal cystine crystal' taught as printed.
